vendor: Honeywell Uniformance PHD RDBMS adapter / ODBC
description: PHD tag definitions from TAG and archived samples from HISTORY, read through the PHD RDBMS adapter.
unverified: TAG view name and TAGNAME/DESCRIPTION/UNIT columns: PHD versions differ between TAG and TAGDEF and some name the tag column TAG.
TAG.RANGE_LOW and TAG.RANGE_HIGH: engineering limits usually come from the PHD tag definition, but these column names need site confirmation.
HISTORY.TIMESTAMP and HISTORY.VALUE: the RDBMS adapter may expose TIME/VAL instead in older installations.
QUALITY ranges: PHD quality is site-configured; the shipped map treats 0 good, 1 uncertain and 2..255 bad.

browse.sql: SELECT TAGNAME, DESCRIPTION, UNIT FROM TAG ORDER BY TAGNAME

metadata.sql: SELECT DESCRIPTION, UNIT, RANGE_LOW, RANGE_HIGH FROM TAG WHERE TAGNAME = ?

history.sql: SELECT TIMESTAMP, VALUE, QUALITY FROM HISTORY WHERE TAGNAME = ? AND TIMESTAMP >= ? AND TIMESTAMP <= ? ORDER BY TIMESTAMP

latest.sql: SELECT TIMESTAMP, VALUE, QUALITY FROM HISTORY WHERE TAGNAME = ? ORDER BY TIMESTAMP DESC LIMIT 1
